mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.name, COUNT(pt.person_id) AS count FROM tag t LEFT JOIN person_tag pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY t.name
SELECT id, name FROM tag WHERE name = #{name}
SELECT t.id, t.name FROM tag t JOIN person_tag pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id WHERE pt.person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY t.name
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO person_tag (person_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{personId}, #{tagId})
